settings.editor: Find answers to your questions about my books, events, and more.

tabs.tab_title: Can I request a signed copy of a book?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, signed copies are available for purchase during special events or through limited-time offers. Keep an eye on the Events page for announcements.

tabs.tab_title: How do I stay updated on new book releases?
tabs.tab_content: Subscribe to my newsletter to get exclusive updates on new releases, events, and behind-the-scenes content.

tabs.tab_title: Are your books available in digital formats?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, all my books are available as eBooks on popular platforms like Kindle and Apple Books. Some are also available as audiobooks.

tabs.tab_title: What genres do you typically write?
tabs.tab_content: My works span across genres, including historical fiction, contemporary drama, and fantasy. Check out the Books page for a full list.

tabs.tab_title: Can I invite Claudia to speak at an event?
tabs.tab_content: Absolutely! Please reach out via the Contact page with details about your event, and I’ll get back to you.
